d:
Akane, the heroine who was reincarnated as a failed hero,
is forced to offer herself to the Demon King as a condition for a truce.
Every night in the Demon King's castle, tentacles devour and develop her while she sleeps...
Akane, who was supposed to be a virgin, has had her entire body developed and
can no longer withstand even the slightest stimulation.
The Demon King devours her ripe body.
"Become mine," "Get pregnant with my child here."
What is the Demon King's true purpose in wanting Akane...? This is a hardcore erotic story with lots of bodily fluids
and includes tentacle play and a story of development.
n: [Doujinshi] [MAXI] Ochikobore tensei yūsha wa ￮ kin kaihatsu sa re maō no dekiai ni ochiru-The underachieving reincarnated hero is subjected to forbidden development and falls into the Demon Lord's doting affection.
